screen.title: Conversation: Adding a course late
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a registrar.

audio.text: Hi, I'd like to add Introduction to Statistics, but the online system says the deadline has passed.
That's right, the add period ended on Friday. You can still join if the instructor signs a late-add form, though.
Oh, good. Do I just bring the form back here?
Yes, but get it signed first. There's also a twenty-dollar late fee, which you pay at the cashier's office.
Okay. I'll email Professor Grant this afternoon.

options: She cannot log in to the online system.
She was charged a fee by mistake.
She missed the deadline to add a class.
She does not know which course to take.

why.en: Problem (paraphrase of "the deadline has passed"). A borrows "online system".
why.tr: Sorun ("deadline has passed" parafrazı). A "online system" ifadesini ödünç alıyor.
why.es: Problema (paráfrasis de "the deadline has passed"). A toma prestado "online system".

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do next?
options: Pay the late fee at the registrar's desk
Return the form without a signature
Wait until the next add period
Contact the instructor of the course

why.en: Inference: she will email Professor Grant to get the signature. A names the wrong office (the fee is paid at the cashier's).
why.tr: Çıkarım: imza için Profesör Grant'e e-posta atacak. A yanlış ofis (ücret kasada ödenir).
why.es: Inferencia: escribirá al profesor Grant para conseguir la firma. A nombra la oficina equivocada (la tasa se paga en caja).
